This Legal Agreement is a contract between you (Client or User) and the UMelec Project Team (Group 9), operating the UMelec application/service for the University of Makati COSEL (the Company or We).

By clicking "I Agree" during registration or by otherwise accessing or using the Service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by the Terms and Conditions of Service (T&Cs). If you do not agree to these terms, you must not use the Service.
This section governs the rules for using the UMelec Service, establishing the legal relationship between the User and the Company, and is governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.
\u2022 Service: The UMelec mobile/web application and all related election services for the University of Makati.
\u2022 Applicable Laws: All relevant laws of the Philippines, including RA 10173 (Data Privacy Act) and RA 8792 (E-Commerce Act).
\u2022 Electronic Signatures: The manual digital signature captured during voting and the required UMak Gmail login credentials used for verification.

This Privacy Policy explains how UMelec Project Team (Group 9), acting as the Personal Information Controller (PIC) for this academic project, collects, uses, protects, and handles your Personal Data in compliance with the Republic Act No. 10173, otherwise known as the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (DPA), and its Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR).

Note on Format (Layered Notice Requirement): In presenting information to you, we adopt the layered privacy notice approach. For the UMelec mobile application, a link to this comprehensive notice is always readily available within the Registration and Profile sections.
1. Identity and Eligibility Data (Voters): Full Name, UMak Gmail, Student ID, Course, College, Year Level, and Encrypted Password (via Firebase Authentication).
2. Identity and Management Data (Leaders/Advisers): Name, Organizational Email, Role, and Encrypted Password.

\u2022 Digital Signature: A manual signature provided upon registration/voting, used strictly for identity verification and ballot integrity (Sensitive Personal Information). This is securely separated from the ballot choices.
\u2022 Encrypted Credentials: Hashed and salted password/credentials stored via Firebase Authentication.

4. Transaction Data (Ballot/Security): Vote selections, Vote ID (Reference Code/Hash), and Digital Signature (Full Hash) for post-election verification. Ballot selections are anonymized from Identity Data immediately after the Digital Signature and Validation (DSA) process.
5. Technical Data/Usage Data: IP address, device type, operating system, application usage logs, and network activity, collected for system maintenance and Audit Trail Monitoring.
Note for Mobile Applications: UMelec may require Automated Notifications permissions (via Firebase Cloud Messaging) to send election alerts and vote confirmations.
\u2022 No Implied Consent: Consent is tied to the explicit actions required to register and vote.

\u2022 Ballot Secrecy: Your consent covers the collection of your vote and identity, but the system guarantees anonymity of the ballot selection by securely separating vote choices from identity data immediately after validation.
\u2022 Firebase Authentication & Cloud Messaging (FCM): Manages secure user credentials and handles notification delivery.
\u2022 Supabase (PostgreSQL) / Database Providers: Stores all core application data, voter lists, and the secure, anonymized ballot tallies.

2. University/COSEL Officials: Data (Name, Student ID, Voting Status, Audit Trail records) is disclosed to authorized Leaders and Advisers for Voter Management, Election Monitoring, Election Approval, and Results Verification.
3. Law Enforcement/Legal: When required by subpoena or official UMak directive.

\u2022 Account Data (Voter/Leader/Adviser): Retained only for the duration of the project deployment period and the subsequent [Specify Contract/Project Duration, e.g., 1-year] period, or as mandated by COSEL for election record keeping.
\u2022 Ballot/Audit Data (Vote ID/Hash): Retained indefinitely as part of the official Audit Trail and election record for transparency and verification purposes.

2. Disposal: Upon the end of the retention period, personal data will be disposed of using secure methods (e.g., secure deletion from PostgreSQL/Supabase). Data forming the essential Audit Trail will be archived securely as required by COSEL/University policy.
\u2022 Encryption: Passwords are hashed and salted via Firebase Authentication. Sensitive data is encrypted both at rest (in Supabase/PostgreSQL) and in transit (using HTTPS/SSL).
\u2022 Ballot Security: The use of Digital Signature and Validation (DSA) ensures ballot integrity and the separation of voter identity from vote choice in the final tally.
\u2022 Monitoring: Continuous Audit Trail Monitoring is implemented for the Adviser/COSEL to detect and respond to suspicious activity.

Personal Data Breach Notification: In the event of a personal data breach, we shall notify the National Privacy Commission and the affected Data Subjects within seventy-two (72) hours upon knowledge of, or when there is reasonable belief, that a breach requiring notification has occurred.
